title: Ten Sheep Short
summary: Something takes one of Hettie's sheep every night. Follow the tracks to its den and end it.
ask: Hettie: Forty sheep in spring. Thirty now. One a night, and never a sound.
Hettie: The tracks go off past the stones. I'm too old to follow them into the dark. You aren't.

steps.text: Follow the tracks to the den
done: Paw prints as wide as your hand. Wool on the brambles. Something lives here.

steps.text: Clear the Gloomstalkers from the den
start: Two shapes uncurl in the shade. They've been eating well.
done: Quiet. Somewhere behind the rocks, a ram complains about everything.

steps.text: Tell Hettie the den is empty
done: Hettie: Gloomstalkers. I should have guessed. They hate a light, you know.
Hettie: Take my old lantern. Hang it up or carry it, and nothing that hunts at night comes close. Forty winters it kept me.
